author: Rotten Tomatoes Trailers
description:
Tom Holland, Jon Bernthal, Jacob Batalon, Sadie Sink, director Destin Daniel Cretton, and producers Amy Pascal and Kevin Feige sit down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Chris Tait to talk about 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'!  They talk about the film's unique vibe within the Marvel universe, Sadie Sink talks about the mystery and fan theories surrounding her character, and director Cretton shares all of the research they did to nail the high-flying physicality!  'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' swings into theaters July 31!
